verdict.rationale: Elicit's Chat can compare and contrast papers and summarize multiple papers along specific dimensions. Its per-paper extraction columns and tables put findings side by side, so an analyst can see differences across sources rather than one blended answer. There is no documented feature that explicitly identifies consensus versus disagreement among sources. One hands-on report also describes a summary that wrongly stated a hypothesis was confirmed, which is the kind of unqualified answer the story wants to avoid. Missing for 10: an explicit agreement/disagreement or consensus view, documentation of how conflicting findings are flagged, and independent corroboration that comparisons surface disagreement reliably.
